# Unwrapped and intentionally broken paragraphs

This paragraph intentionally occupies one source line even though it is considerably longer than the default one hundred and twenty character limit.

Two trailing spaces  
are an intentional break.

An odd backslash\
is an intentional break.

Three backslashes \\\
are also an intentional break.

Before a tag<br>
after a tag.

Before a tag
<br/>after a tag.

> Quoted text  
> with an intentional break.

- A list paragraph on one line.
- [x] A completed task on one line.

[^note]: A footnote on one line.

```md
Code block contents
are not paragraphs.
```

    Indented code
    is not a paragraph.

HTML block contents
are not paragraphs.
</div>
